judge_note: Complaints 1-2 star with dates [judge: sonnet op2b3]
answer: 4.6 out of 5 stars, 7,022 ratings — top 1–2★ complaints (past 12 months): (1) arrives dented/damaged or used-and-dirty rather than new, e.g. "dented all over and seemed used" (Oct 3, 2025); (2) won't seal / won't reach pressure or dies within weeks–months, e.g. "after 3 months it won't lock, steam keeps escaping" (Jan 17, 2026); (3) poor cooking results — food burns to the bottom and rice/beans cook badly, e.g. "food burns before it can pressurize" (Mar 19, 2026)
